Landing.heroSubtitle: Manage your personal and business finances in one place. Simple, secure, and powerful.
Landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to take control of your money
Landing.feature1Desc: Create and manage multiple accounts in different currencies. Keep a clear record of every balance.
Landing.feature2Desc: Record income and expenses instantly. Categorize every transaction to understand where your money goes.
Landing.feature3Desc: Your data is protected with end-to-end encryption. Each user can only access their own information.
Landing.feature4Desc: Track credits you receive and those you grant. Monitor installments, payments, and outstanding balances.
Landing.feature5Desc: Visualize income and expense trends with clear charts. Make data-driven decisions.
Landing.feature6Desc: Modern interface that loads instantly. No complications, no delays, no excuses to stay organized.
Landing.benefit1: Designed for individuals and small businesses that want order without complications.
Landing.benefit2: Multi-currency: handle pesos, dollars, and any other currency you need.
Landing.benefit3: No hidden costs. Start free and scale when you need it.
Landing.faq1Answer: Yes. TwinCap is free for personal and small business use. There are no hidden costs or mandatory plans.
Landing.faq2Answer: Absolutely. Your data is encrypted and each user has exclusive access to their own information. No one else can see your finances.
Landing.faq3Answer: Yes. TwinCap supports multiple currencies. You can create accounts in different currencies and transfer between them.
Landing.faq4Question: Do I need to install anything?
Landing.faq4Answer: No. TwinCap works from your web browser. You can also install it as an app on your phone for quick access.

Help.title: Help center
Help.subtitle: Answers to the most frequently asked questions about TwinCap.
Help.faqAccountsQ: How do I add an account?
Help.faqAccountsA: Go to Accounts and tap Create account. Choose the name, type, and, if you want, the initial balance.
Help.faqTransferQ: How do I transfer between accounts?
Help.faqTransferA: Go to Transfers and tap New transfer. Select the source account, the destination, and the amount. Remember an internal transfer is neither income nor expense.
Help.faqCreditQ: How do I record a credit?
Help.faqCreditA: TwinCap records received credits (funding you get) and granted credits (loans you make). Each payment amortizes principal first; only the surplus is income.
Help.faqSalesQ: How do I record a sale?
Help.faqSalesA: Go to Sales and tap New sale. You can pick a catalog item or create a new one, and record the sale as cash or on credit.
Help.faqSecurityQ: Is my money and data safe?
Help.faqSecurityA: Your information is stored encrypted and only you have access to it. See our Privacy Policy for more detail.
Help.contactBody: If you didn't find the answer here, write to us and we'll help you shortly.
